- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The agriculture industry thrives along the Elbe River, growing crops like wheat, barley, and potatoes, and transporting livestock.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Elbe River is a popular destination for river cruises, attracting thousands of tourists annually for scenic views and historical sites.
